ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious File Encoded To Base64 Via Certutil.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of certutil with the "encode" flag to encode a file to base64 where the extensions of the file is suspicious

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CertUtil\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-encode.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/encode.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.acl.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.doc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.gif.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jpeg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jpg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.mp3.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pdf.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.png.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ppt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.tmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.xls.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.xml.*")))
